modelIdentity: Both fresh Codex agents inherit the coordinating task model; exact API model identifier is not exposed. This is session independence, not independent provider families.
blinding: Only packet, instructions and AGENTS.md permitted. Candidate identities, prompt variants, automatic scores, runtime/cost metadata, reference notes, calibration labels and the other review withheld. Procedural restriction on a shared filesystem, not access isolation.
controls: Six newly authored answers in three source pairs, with eighteen fixed expected checks. They are agent-authored sanity checks, not human gold. Preserve mismatches and review disagreements, including concerns about an expected label; do not revise labels after seeing judgments.
reviewScope: Every valid validation answer, every field, all six rubric criteria; no valid answer is excluded because it fails automatic checks. Operational failures have no valid output to review.
dataFiles: The ignored packet and controller are reproducible with eval:ai-review from the committed validation run, context brief and review-controls.json.
